title: Osteoblast differentiation and skeletal development are regulated by Mdm2-p53 signaling

grounded.evidence_quote: Mdm2 complexes with p53 and negatively regulates p53-induced transcription of target genes, including the Mdm2 gene

grounded.context: review statement of response to cellular insult
grounded.evidence_quote: During times of cellular insult, p53 activates Mdm2 gene expression by binding to a p53 response element within the first intron of the Mdm2 gene

grounded.context: postconfluent differentiating mouse calvarial osteoblast cultures
grounded.evidence_quote: These genes are targets of p53 transactivation known to be involved in regulating the progression of primary cells from G1 into S phase of the cell cycle
grounded.location: Results - Negative regulation of p53 by Mdm2 is required for proper osteoblast differentiation
